name: Phase 3 — Career & Learning
objective: Build resource hub, job portal, resume builder, placement tracking, alumni networking, and global search for ISDB-BISEW Connect.
exit_criteria: Resources can be uploaded, categorized, searched, rated, and downloaded
Jobs and internships can be posted, applied to, and tracked
Resume builder extracts profile data and exports as structured view
Placements track students, companies, and success rates
Alumni directory, mentorship requests, and success stories are functional
Global search indexes users, posts, groups, jobs, resources
